statutory_enactments.act_name: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act (PWDVA), 2005 & Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005
statutory_enactments.impact: Created civil protection/residence orders for domestic abuse and granted daughters equal coparcenary rights in ancestral property

statutory_enactments.act_name: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
statutory_enactments.impact: Established gender-neutral statutory framework and special courts for child protection

statutory_enactments.act_name: Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 (Nirbhaya Act) & Workplace POSH Act, 2013
statutory_enactments.impact: Expanded statutory offense definitions, penalized police non-registration of FIRs (Sec 166A IPC), and mandated workplace Internal Complaints Committees
Doubled paid formal-sector maternity leave from 12 weeks to 26 weeks and mandated workplace creches

statutory_enactments.act_name: Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2018 & Fast Track Special Courts (FTSC) Scheme (2019)
statutory_enactments.impact: Mandated capital punishment for aggravated offenses against girls under 12 and operationalized 774 FTSCs (413 exclusive POCSO courts) disposing >2.5 lakh cases

statutory_enactments.act_name: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019
statutory_enactments.impact: Outlawed and criminalized instant Triple Talaq, reducing incidence by over 80%

statutory_enactments.act_name: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam [Constitution (106th Amendment) Act, 2023]
statutory_enactments.impact: Enacted 33% reservation for women in Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies after 27 years of legislative deadlock

manifesto_tracker.promise: Legal Guarantee of 100 Days Rural Wage Employment (MGNREGA)
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted National Rural Employment Guarantee Act in Aug 2005 guaranteeing 100 days of unskilled wage employment per rural household; scaled nationwide by April 2008.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Act No. 42 of 2005 (Gazette Notification Sep 7, 2005)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Enactment of Statutory Right to Information (RTI)
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted Right to Information Act, 2005 establishing Central and State Information Commissions with 30-day statutory public disclosure timelines.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Act No. 22 of 2005 (Effective Oct 12, 2005)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Recognition of Tribal and Forest Dweller Tenure Rights
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted the Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006 vesting individual and community forest land titles.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Act No. 2 of 2007 (Gazette Notification Dec 29, 2006)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Universal Free and Compulsory Elementary Education (RTE)
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009 operationalizing Article 21A for children aged 6-14 years with 25% EWS private school quota.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Act No. 35 of 2009 (Effective Apr 1, 2010)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Indo-US Civil Nuclear Agreement & NSG Waiver
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Concluded bilateral 123 Agreement with the US and secured the Sep 2008 NSG clean waiver, ending 34 years of nuclear isolation.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: India-US 123 Agreement (Signed Oct 10, 2008); IAEA INFCIRC/754

manifesto_tracker.promise: National Food Security Act (Right to Subsidized Foodgrains)
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted NFSA 2013 covering 75% rural and 50% urban population with 5 kg foodgrains per person per month at subsidized prices.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Act No. 20 of 2013 (Gazette Notification Sep 10, 2013)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Aadhaar Unique ID & Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Rollout
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Created UIDAI via executive order in Jan 2009 and launched pilot DBT in 43 districts in Jan 2013; however, statutory Aadhaar bill failed to pass and >40% poor lacked bank accounts in 2014.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Planning Commission Notification Jan 28, 2009

manifesto_tracker.promise: Independent Anti-Corruption Lokpal Ombudsman Operationalization
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act in Dec 2013, but zero Chairperson or Members were appointed before UPA left office in May 2014.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Act No. 1 of 2014 (Notified Jan 1, 2014; Operationalized Mar 2019)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Nationwide Goods and Services Tax (GST) Rollout by April 2010
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Promised in 2009 INC Manifesto; Constitution (115th Amendment) Bill, 2011 remained stalled over state compensation and lapsed with the 15th Lok Sabha in 2014.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Bill No. 22 of 2011 (Lapsed May 2014)

manifesto_tracker.promise: 33% Reservation for Women in Lok Sabha and State Assemblies
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Constitution (108th Amendment) Bill passed Rajya Sabha in March 2010 but was never brought to a vote in Lok Sabha by UPA-II and lapsed in 2014.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Rajya Sabha Debate Record, Mar 9, 2010 (Lapsed May 2014)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Elimination of Union Revenue Deficit by FY 2008-09 (FRBM Mandate)
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Revenue deficit surged to 4.5% of GDP in FY09 and 5.2% in FY10, remaining at 3.2% in FY14 alongside unbudgeted oil/fertilizer bonds.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Ministry of Finance White Paper on the Indian Economy (Feb 2024)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Abrogation of Article 370 & Full Constitutional Integration of J&K
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Issued Constitutional Orders C.O. 272 and 273 and enacted J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019 ending special status and applying all Union laws to J&K and Ladakh.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: C.O. 272 & 273; Act No. 34 of 2019 (Gazette Notification Aug 9, 2019)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Implementation of Nationwide Goods and Services Tax (GST)
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted Constitution (101st Amendment) Act, 2016 and CGST/IGST Acts, launching GST nationwide on July 1, 2017.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Constitution (101st Amendment) Act, Sep 8, 2016; Acts No. 12-15 of 2017

manifesto_tracker.promise: Facilitation of Grand Ram Mandir Construction at Ayodhya
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Following unanimous Supreme Court verdict (Nov 9, 2019), established Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust in Feb 2020; temple consecrated Jan 22, 2024.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: MHA Gazette Notification S.O. 562(E), Feb 5, 2020

manifesto_tracker.promise: Enactment of Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA) for Persecuted Minorities
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019 and notified operational CAA Rules in March 2024 granting citizenship certificates to persecuted minorities.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Act No. 47 of 2019; MHA Rules G.S.R. 172(E), Mar 11, 2024

manifesto_tracker.promise: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) & Banking NPA Resolution
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted IBC 2016 establishing time-bound creditor-in-control resolution; SCB GNPA ratio reduced to a 12-year low of 2.8% by March 2024.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Act No. 31 of 2016 (May 28, 2016); RBI FSR June 2024

manifesto_tracker.promise: Abolition of Instant Triple Talaq & 33% Women's Reservation in Legislatures
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 and Constitution (106th Amendment) Act, 2023 [Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam].
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Act No. 20 of 2019 (Jul 31, 2019) & 106th Amendment (Sep 28, 2023)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Overhaul of Colonial Criminal Laws (IPC, CrPC, Evidence Act)
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Enacted Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), effective July 1, 2024.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Acts No. 45, 46 & 47 of 2023 (Gazette Notification Dec 25, 2023)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Implementation of One Rank One Pension (OROP) & Chief of Defence Staff (CDS)
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Implemented OROP in Nov 2015 (effective Jul 1, 2014) disbursing >Rs 1 Lakh Cr in arrears, and created CDS & Dept of Military Affairs in Dec 2019.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: MoD Order Nov 7, 2015 & Cabinet Notification Dec 24, 2019

manifesto_tracker.promise: Creation of 100 Operational Smart Cities
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Operationalized Integrated Command and Control Centres (ICCCs) in all 100 cities and completed >90% of ~8,000 projects worth Rs 1.44+ lakh crore under extended March 2025 timeline.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: MoHUA Smart Cities Mission Dashboard & Parliamentary Replies (2024-25)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Doubling Farmers' Real Income by 2022
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Launched PM-KISAN (>Rs 3.2 Lakh Cr transferred), raised MSPs to 1.5x cost (A2+FL), and expanded horticulture (362 MMT) and fisheries (195 LMT); nominal incomes rose significantly though real inflation-adjusted doubling by 2022 was only partially achieved.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: NSO 77th Round SAS & Ministry of Agriculture PIB Records (2025)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Ahmedabad-Mumbai High-Speed Rail (Bullet Train) Completion by 2022
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: 100% land acquisition, 300+ km viaduct construction, and undersea tunnel breakthrough completed after 2019-2022 Maharashtra land delays; trial run targeted for 2026 and full commissioning by 2028.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: Ministry of Railways / NHSRCL Progress Reports (2024-2025)

manifesto_tracker.promise: Raising Manufacturing Share to 25% of GDP
manifesto_tracker.official_outcome: Launched Make in India and Rs 1.97 Lakh Cr PLI schemes across 14 sectors, boosting electronics, pharma, biotech ($130B), and defence production (Rs 1.78 Lakh Cr); however, aggregate manufacturing GVA share remains near 16%-17.3% of GDP.
manifesto_tracker.gazette_or_record_ref: MoSPI National Accounts Statistics & Economic Survey 2024-25

diplomacyTradeAndIntelligence.sectionTitle: 4. Diplomacy, Trade Deals & Intelligence Influence (R&AW vs. MSS)
diplomacyTradeAndIntelligence.sourceCitation: SOURCE: MEA INDIA, MINISTRY OF COMMERCE, PTI, GREENFDC & OPEN-SOURCE INT
diplomacyTradeAndIntelligence.dataConstraintNotice: DATA CONSTRAINT: Exact budgets and personnel counts for external intelligence agencies—India's Research and Analysis Wing (R&AW) and China's Ministry of State Security (MSS)—are classified state secrets. Capabilities are evaluated below via strategic trade posture, diplomatic milestones, and institutional mandates.

indiaHighlights.agencyFounded: Est. 1968 • Reports directly to Prime Minister's Office (PMO) & Cabinet Secretariat
indiaHighlights.technicalWings: Aviation Research Centre (ARC), Electronics & Technical Services (ETS), Radio Research Center (RRC)

strategicChecklist.title: Exited RCEP Mega-Pact in Bangkok
strategicChecklist.description: Withdrew from the 16-nation Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership in November 2019 to safeguard domestic manufacturing, MSMEs, and dairy/agriculture from asymmetrical Chinese import surges.

strategicChecklist.title: Pivoted to Targeted Bilateral Trade Deals (UAE & Australia)
strategicChecklist.description: Implemented the India-UAE CEPA and Australia-India ECTA in 2022 (pushing two-way Australia trade to A$48.9B–$54.4B), alongside Press Note 3 screening on land-border FDI.

strategicChecklist.title: Pushed 'Neighborhood First' & 'Act East' Policies
strategicChecklist.description: Anchored Bay of Bengal connectivity via the 6th BIMSTEC Summit (2025), chaired IORA (2025–2027), and expanded the NSA-level Colombo Security Conclave across the Indian Ocean Region.

strategicChecklist.title: Elevated Status via QUAD, G20 Presidency & UNSC Advocacy
strategicChecklist.description: Deepened Indo-Pacific maritime domain awareness (MAITRI) and semiconductor resilience via the QUAD, led Global South initiatives at the 2023 G20, and pressed for a permanent UNSC seat via G4.

strategicChecklist.title: LAC Reconnaissance & Regional Counter-Terrorism Focus
strategicChecklist.description: Leverages ARC aerial/satellite reconnaissance along the 3,400 km Line of Actual Control (LAC), SIGINT/ELINT monitoring in the Indian Ocean, and counter-intelligence against regional terror networks.

chinaHighlights.agencyFounded: Est. 1983 • State Council & CCP Central Committee Political-Legal Commission
chinaHighlights.technicalWings: Foreign & Domestic Bureaus, Cyber/AI Espionage Units & CICIR Analytical Institute

strategicChecklist.title: Expanded Belt & Road Initiative (BRI) to $1.399 Trillion
strategicChecklist.description: Signed MoUs with ~150 nations; recorded an all-time high $213.6B BRI engagement in 2025 ($128.4B construction, $85.2B investment), with Pakistan as the #1 cumulative energy recipient ($41.5B).

strategicChecklist.title: Brokered High-Profile Middle East Diplomatic Accords
strategicChecklist.description: Mediated the historic March 2023 Saudi Arabia–Iran normalization pact in Beijing (ending a 7-year rift) and facilitated the July 2024 Beijing Declaration among Palestinian factions.

strategicChecklist.title: Leveraged Upstream Manufacturing & Trade Asymmetry
strategicChecklist.description: Remains India's largest source of industrial imports ($131.6B in FY25-26, generating a $99.2B–$112.6B deficit), supplying 43% of India's electronics, 40% of machinery/computers, and 44% of organic chemicals.

strategicChecklist.title: Institutionalized Alternative Multilateral Lending
strategicChecklist.description: Expanded sovereign lending, RMB trade settlement, and infrastructure financing through the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) and the Shanghai-headquartered New Development Bank (NDB).

strategicChecklist.title: Global Cyber-Industrial Espionage & C3I Surveillance
strategicChecklist.description: Combines internal political security with global HUMINT, AI-driven mass data harvesting, defense/semiconductor IP acquisition, and surveillance of Indian nuclear C3I and Indo-US convergence.
